question.question: In parallelogram $ABCD$, $AE = DC = 8\,\text{cm}$ and $AB = 18\,\text{cm}$. Find $EB$ and explain why $\angle AEC = \angle ADC$.
question.referenceAnswer: $EB = AB - AE = 18 - 8 = 10\,\text{cm}$. Since $EC \parallel AD$, $AECD$ is a parallelogram, so opposite angles are equal: $\angle AEC = \angle ADC$.
question.evidence: $EB = AB - AE = (18 - 8)\,\text{cm} = 10\,\text{cm}$; $\angle AEC = \angle ADC = 110^\circ \quad (\text{opp. } \angle s \text{ of //gram})$
